dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh! Ya still got a long way to go, <$cdef(27)>Mr. Mime! Might wanna
consider relearnin’ the fundamentals, I reckon!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Ainda tem um longo caminho a percorrer. <$cdef(27)>Mr. MimeTalvez queira.
considerar reaprender’ os fundamentos, eu acho!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Yooo... Seriously? I thought I was doin’ pretty good...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Yooo ... Sério? Eu pensei que eu estava indo 'muito bem...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,43)>Ya won’t intimidate any opponents with slaps like those!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,43)>Você não vai intimidar nenhum adversário com tapas como esses!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, uh, these aren’t slap attacks or whatever, yo. I was
pantomiming.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, uh, estes não são ataques de tapas ou o que quer que seja, yo. Eu estava
pantomimando.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>Panta what now?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>Panta o quê?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,814)><$comeff(2,10)>Uh, y’know, like...if I move like this, it makes you think
there’s a wall here you can’t see.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>It’s pretty fun. You should give it a go, <$cdef(27)>Hariyama!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,814)><$comeff(2,10)>sabe, tipo... se eu me mexer assim, faz-te pensar
há uma parede aqui que você não pode ver.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>É muito divertido. Você deve dar-lhe uma chance, <$cdef(27)>Hariyama!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Well I’ll be... Them’s some fancy moves ya got there.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)>S’pose I can give it a try. Let’s see, now...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,629)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!!!<$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,5)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Bem, eu vou ser... Eles são alguns movimentos extravagantes que você tem lá.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)>Suponha que eu possa dar-lhe uma tentativa. Vejamos, agora...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,629)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!!!!<$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,5)>

dialogues.en: <turn(1,270)><$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)><$motionoff(2,805)>Uhhh... You’re not s’posed to BREAK the wall, yo...
dialogues.pt_br: <turn(1,270)><$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)><$motionoff(2,805)>Uhhh... Você não está obrigado a quebrar a parede, yo...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>Gahaha! That so? Well, it was good trainin’ for me anyhow,
I tell ya what!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>Gahaha! Isso é assim? Bem, foi bom treinar’ para mim de qualquer maneira,
Digo-te uma coisa!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>OK, next it’s my turn to hide!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>OK, a seguir é a minha vez de me esconder!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Don’t worry, I’ll find you real quick. I’m good at
hide-and-seek! The seeking part in particular.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Não se preocupe, eu vou encontrá-lo muito rapidamente. Eu sou bom em
A parte que procura em particular.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hmph! I’ll hide so good you’ll NEVER find me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hmph! Eu vou me esconder tão bem que você nunca vai me encontrar!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>But that’s what I mean!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>You’re thinking real hard about hiding, and thoughts like
that leak out.<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)> I pick up on things like that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>Mas é isso que eu quero dizer!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Você está pensando muito sobre se esconder, e pensamentos como
Que a fuga se espalhou.<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)> Recolho coisas assim!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh? Really? OK, so what am I thinking now? Guess!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>O que estou a pensar agora?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmmm...
<$emotion(2,29)>You’re thinking about cheating, aren’t you?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmmm...
<$emotion(2,29)>Você está pensando em trapacear, não está?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Um, no... I wasn’t gonna cheat! I was just gonna
camouflage myself as something to help me hide!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Um, não... Eu não ia trapacear! Eu só ia
camuflar-me como algo para me ajudar a esconder!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,6)>That’s cheating!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,6)>Isso é trapaça!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Umm...well...uh... Oh, I know!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ve got a quiz for you! What am I thinking NOW?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu sei!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu tenho um questionário para você! O que eu estou pensando AGORA?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Let me see...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>“I’m done with hide-and-seek, but maybe you could say
my camouflage skills are really cool”?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Deixa-me ver...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>“Estou farto de esconde-esconde, mas talvez você possa dizer
minhas habilidades de camuflagem são muito legais”?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>WOWWW! You got it!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Conseguiste!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey... Don’tcha think we kinda look alike?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey... Você não acha que somos parecidos?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Hmmm... You think so?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Achas que sim?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Yeah, we really do! See, look at our ears—and the fur on
top of our heads!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Olha para as nossas orelhas e o pêlo.
Em cima das nossas cabeças!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,14)>Now that you mention it...I guess we do! Weird!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,14)>Agora que fala nisso... acho que sim!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪ D’you think maybe we’re TWINS?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ? Você acha que talvez nós somos TWINS?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Oh wow! I should call you Big Sis <$cdef(27)>Zorua from now on!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Wait... It looks like we have a different number of tails.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Devia chamar-te irmã mais velha. <$cdef(27)>Zorua De agora em diante!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Parece que temos um número diferente de caudas.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,807)>Huh? Oh, you’re right... Everything else matches, so I
wonder how come that’s different...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)>Oh, I know!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,807)>Ah, você está certo... Tudo o resto combina, então eu
perguntar como isso é diferente...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)>Eu sei!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>What is it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>O que foi?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>I bet I’m gonna have six tails, too! They just haven’t grown
in yet!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Eu aposto que eu vou ter seis caudas, também! Eles só não cresceram
Ainda não entrei!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>If that happens, no one’ll be able to tell us apart anymore!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Se isso acontecer, ninguém mais poderá nos distinguir!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Raichu</color>! Battle time, let’s go!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Raichu</color>Hora da batalha, vamos!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Oh, my! You’re back for another electricity contest? You’re
always bursting with energy, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Nossa! Você está de volta para outro concurso de eletricidade?
sempre estourando de energia, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>Today’s the day I take you down! Here I go!
<$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUU!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>Hoje é o dia em que te levo para baixo! Aqui vou eu!
<$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUUUU!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Goodness, how impressive! You’ve powered up since last
time, dear!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Nossa, que impressionante! Você tem alimentado desde a última vez
Tempo, querida!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Ehehe! Sounds like this’ll be an easy win, then!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Ehehe! Parece que esta vai ser uma vitória fácil, então!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hee hee... Well, I suppose I’d better not hold back...
<$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUUUUU!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hee hee... Bem, acho que é melhor eu não me conter...
<$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUUUUUUU!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,665)><$comeff(1,11)>HUH?! So much electricity, it’s unreal!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,665)><$comeff(1,11)>Quanta eletricidade, é irreal!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>*gasp*... *huff puff*...
... ... ...
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,6)>So...how did you like my *huff*...electricity?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>* Gasp * * Puff *...
... ... ...
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,6)>Então... gostaste da minha energia elétrica?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)>Urk... Fine—you beat me THIS time!
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>See ya tomorrow, then!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)>Pronto, desta vez ganhaste-me!
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Até amanhã, então!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>*wheeze*... *gasp* W-we’re doing this...tomorrow, too?
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Guess I’d better charge up somewhere... Oh, to be young
and full of energy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Vamos fazer isto amanhã, também?
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Acho que é melhor eu carregar em algum lugar... Oh, para ser jovem
e cheio de energia!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>I hear you’ve been talkin’ big around these parts.
That true?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Ouvi dizer que você tem falado muito por estas partes.
É verdade?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! Sure is! ’Cause there ain’t nobody who can
beat me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Wanna battle me ’n’ see fer yerself?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! Claro que é! ‘Porque não há ninguém que possa
Bate-me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>quer lutar comigo e ver-te a ti mesmo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Interestin’ proposition! I ain’t never lost a battle myself...
You’re on!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Interessin’ proposição! Eu nunca perdi uma batalha eu mesmo...
Você está dentro!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Never lost a battle, ya say? Gwahaha! Then I guess it’s up
to ME to send ya packin’ <$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>with one of my best moves!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Nunca perdeu uma batalha, diz tu? Então eu acho que é para cima
a ME para enviar ya packin’ <$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>com um dos meus melhores movimentos!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oho! That’s a powerful move ya got there! I can see why
you’re so fulla bluster!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>But that powerful move ain’t worth much if it can’t hit me!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,4)>*fwoooooosh*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oho! Essa é uma jogada poderosa que você tem lá! Eu posso ver por que
você é tão cheio de bluster!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Mas esse movimento poderoso não vale muito se não puder me atingir!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,4)>* Fwoooooosh *

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! You pulled a disappearin’ act on me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>O quê?! Você fez um ato de desaparecimento em mim!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,7)>Gwahaha! Well? Still think ya can beat me?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,7)>Ainda achas que me consegues vencer?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>You’re certainly makin’ it harder to aim, but I ain’t beat
yet! <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>GRAAAHR! <$cdef(27)>Rock Slide combo attack!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Você certamente está tornando mais difícil de mirar, mas eu não estou derrotado
Ainda! <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>Graaahh! <$cdef(27)>Slide de Rocha Ataque combinado!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Whoa! Careful now! I reckon ya’d feel real bad if ya hit
<$cdef(27)> with a stray rock!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Cuidado agora! Eu acho que você se sentiria muito mal se você bater
<$cdef(27)> com uma pedra perdida!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Grrrah! Guess I got a li’l too fired up! Sorry ’bout
that, <$cdef(27)>...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Grrrah! Acho que eu tenho um li'l muito animado! Desculpe 'bout
que, <$cdef(27)>...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Phew. You’re a wild one, all right... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,2)>Ya may never have lost
a battle, but ya lose yer cool pretty often, don’t ya?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Ufa. Você é selvagem, tudo bem... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,2)>Você pode nunca ter perdido
uma batalha, mas você perde você mais legal muitas vezes, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m the best at mimicry! Just watch!
<$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)>See? It’s you when you’re flying!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu sou o melhor em mimetismo! Basta assistir!
<$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)>Vê? É você quando você está voando!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(2,8)>I’M the best at mimicry! Just watch, yo!
<$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(2,10)>See? It’s you when you’re flying!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu sou o melhor em mimetismo! Basta assistir, yo!
<$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(2,10)>Vê? É você quando você está voando!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Wha—?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>O quê? !

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I was mimicking you! Sounded JUST like you, didn’t it?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Looks like I’m the best at mimicry for real, huh?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu estava imitando você! Soou como você, não foi?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Parece que eu sou o melhor em mimetismo de verdade, hein?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I-I’m not gonna give up that easily! I’ve still got some
tricks up my sleeve...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu-eu não vou desistir tão facilmente! Eu ainda tenho alguns
truques na minha manga...

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>!
Come to think of it, <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>you’ve been mimicking a human
this whole time, haven’t you?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>!
Pensando bem, <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>você tem imitado um ser humano
Este tempo todo, não foi?

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Yooo... I hate to admit it, but I dunno if I’d stand a chance
against <$cdef(27)>...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Yooo... Eu odeio admitir isso, mas eu não sei se eu teria uma chance
contra <$cdef(27)>...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Yeah... I’d get exhausted trying to mimic something for
so long...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Sim... Eu ficaria exausto tentando imitar algo para
Adeus...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, uh, then I guess the winner of the best mimicker
contest is...<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Então, acho que o vencedor do melhor imitador
O concurso é...<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>Ah... Watch out!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>Cuidado!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,9)>Pahhh?! That scared me... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What was that all the sudden?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso assustou-me... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>O que foi aquilo de repente?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, I saw a tree branch flying on the wind this way, so I
merely sliced it away. <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>You’re not injured, are you?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Vi um galho de árvore a voar no vento desta maneira, por isso...
Apenas a rasguei. <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Você não está ferido, está?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh...I’m fine, thank you!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>I have to say, you looked so cool just now, <$cdef(27)>Empoleon! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>You
were all like “swish!”
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>Estou bem, obrigado!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Tenho de dizer, está tão fixe agora. <$cdef(27)>Empoleon! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Você.
eram todos como “swish!”

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah, you’re referring to the move I used to cut the branch?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah, você está se referindo ao movimento que eu usei para cortar o galho?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Yeah! That’s what I meant! I couldn’t see it well because
it was so fast... <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Could you do it again, please?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Sim! Isso é o que eu quis dizer! Eu não podia vê-lo bem porque
Foi tão rápido... <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>pode repetir, por favor?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,5)>Yes, of course. A trivial task. Now watch closely... <wait(1.0)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>Yah!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,5)>Sim, claro, uma tarefa trivial. <wait(1.0)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>Sim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow, amazing! How do you do that? <$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,4)>N-not that I want to
try to do it or anything...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Como é que fazes isso? <$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,4)>Não que eu queira.
Tenta fazê-lo ou qualquer coisa...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,9)>Haha, you’re perfectly capable of it. Why not attempt it
and see for yourself?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,9)>Haha, você é perfeitamente capaz de fazê-lo.
e ver por si mesmo?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Wha—?! R-really?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sério?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ll give you a slower demonstration. Try to do as I do.
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,8)>Yah! Like that.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Vou dar-lhe uma demonstração mais lenta. Tente fazer o que eu faço.
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,8)>Assim.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,5)>All right, I can do this... <$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,10)>Yah!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>How was that? I thought it was pretty good...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,5)>Está bem, eu consigo fazer isto... <$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Pensei que era muito bom...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Heh heh. You have admirable form. I look forward to
seeing what the future holds for you.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Você tem uma forma admirável.
ver o que o futuro te reserva.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Jolteon</color>... Do you only eat one kind of berry?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Jolteon</color>Só comes um tipo de baga?

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Huh? No, why?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Não, porquê?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Well, your home’s filled with piles of the same berry.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Bem, sua casa está cheia de pilhas da mesma baga.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Ohhh, you mean my snack stash! Funny story: I grabbed a
berry to eat later, <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>and next thing I knew, it was gone!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>But these things happen, right? So I went out to pick up
another one, but when I came back, I found the old one.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>And I always grab the same kind of berry to replace the
one I thought I lost!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Ohhh, quer dizer o meu stock de lanches!
bagas para comer mais tarde, <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>E quando me dei conta, tinha desaparecido!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Mas estas coisas acontecem, certo?
Outro, mas quando voltei, encontrei o antigo.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>E eu sempre pego o mesmo tipo de baga para substituir o
Uma que eu pensei que tinha perdido!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Wait, this happened more than once? And that’s why you
have so many? Wow, <$cdef(27)>Jolteon... You’re something else.
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Say, why don’t I help you clear some of them away?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Espere, isso aconteceu mais de uma vez? E é por isso que você
Tem tantos? <$cdef(27)>Jolteon... Você é outra coisa.
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Diga, por que não o ajudo a eliminar alguns deles?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoa, you serious? That’d be awesome!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>To be honest, it’s kinda annoying when I wake up to find
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>a bunch of berries stuck on my spiky bod.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>If you don’t mind helping me tidy, I’d really appreciate it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Uau, você está falando sério? Isso seria incrível!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Para ser honesto, é meio irritante quando eu acordo para encontrar
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Um monte de bagas presas no meu corpo.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Se você não se importa de me ajudar a arrumar, eu realmente apreciaria!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>No problem, just leave it to me.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>First, I’ll flood your whole place with a gush of water...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Não há problema, deixa comigo.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Primeiro, vou inundar todo o seu lugar com um gostinho de água...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, hey, hold up, pal! My home’ll get totally soaked if
you do that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, hey, espere, amigo! Minha casa vai ficar totalmente encharcado se
Faz isso!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, yeah. The berries get washed away, plus your home
gets nice and damp. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s the problem?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, as bagas são lavadas, e a tua casa.
fica agradável e úmido. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Qual é o problema?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>The problem? Well, I don’t really wanna live in a wetland,
for starters...
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Y’know what, forget about it. I’ll get rid of ’em myself...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>O problema? Bem, eu realmente não quero viver em uma terra molhada,
para começar...
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Você sabe o quê, esqueça isso. Eu mesmo vou me livrar deles...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey! Could I have some of your wool?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Dás-me um pouco da tua lã?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sure... But why, though?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Claro... mas porquê?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>I just thought that if I filled my home with your wool, it’d
be all fluffy and nice!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu só pensei que se eu encheu minha casa com sua lã,
Sejam fofos e simpáticos!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>But my wool is so light, it could get blown away if
it’s ever windy, y’know.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas a minha lã é tão leve, que pode ser soprada se
é sempre ventoso, você sabe.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh, right... That’s not good...
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Wait! If we combined a bunch of wool with my string,
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>could that keep it from blowing away?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Ah, certo... isso não é bom...
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Se juntássemos um monte de lã com o meu fio,
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Isso pode impedir que se expluda?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ohhh, yeah! You might be a genius... <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>That sounds
fun, so lemme, y’know, help out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>pode ser um génio... <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Parece que sim.
divertido, então deixe-me, você sabe, ajudar!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks! Now the question is, <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>HOW do we combine your
wool and my string...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Agora a pergunta é: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>COMO é que combinamos o seu
Lã e o meu fio...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know, the idea of combining wool and string kinda
reminds me of <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>those human tools
<$cdef(27)> makes.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Você sabe, a idéia de combinar lã e corda tipo
lembra-me de... <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>essas ferramentas humanas
<$cdef(27)> Faz.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>You’re right! Let’s start by getting something made by
<$cdef(27)>,
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>and
studying
it carefully!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>Você está certo! Vamos começar por obter algo feito por
<$cdef(27)>,
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>e
estudando
Com cuidado!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Yeahhh! Study buddies! <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,10)>Woot woot!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Amigos de estudo! <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,10)>Woot woot!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>Woo-hoo!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>Woo-hoo!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey! You don’t know any good hiding spots, do you?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Ei! Você não conhece nenhum bom esconderijo, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Hiding spots?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm... How about inside a cave or in the shade of a tree?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>No one will bother you there, so you can rest easy.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Escondidas?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Que tal dentro de uma caverna ou à sombra de uma árvore?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Ninguém vai incomodá-lo lá, para que possa descansar.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,7)>Nah, that’s no fun! I wanna find a spot where I can hide
then jump <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>out and scare folks! Hehe!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,7)>Não, isso não é divertido! Eu quero encontrar um lugar onde eu posso esconder
então pule. <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Saiam e assustem as pessoas!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh dear. Up to a little mischief, are you? I wonder what
I would do if you pulled that little prank on me.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Perhaps I’d wrap you up tightly in a bundle of my thread...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, querido, está a tramar alguma?
Eu faria se me pregasses essa partida.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Talvez eu o embrulhasse firmemente em um pacote de meu fio...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Uh...what?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>O quê?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Then I’d hang you up and leave you there, alone, afraid...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Então eu o pendurava e o deixava lá, sozinho, com medo...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,10)>Whoa, WHAT?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,10)>Whoa, o quê?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Don’t worry, I’m only teasing! I would never do that.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Não se preocupe, estou apenas brincando! Eu nunca faria isso.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>O-oh! Haha, good one!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>Boa!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>But don’t you think troublemakers who thoughtlessly
frighten others deserve a taste of their own medicine?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I certainly do. That is why you mustn’t pull too many
pranks, little <$cdef(27)>Gastly. Otherwise, well...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas você não acha que os encrenqueiros que sem pensar
Assustar os outros merece um pouco de seu próprio remédio?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu certamente faço. É por isso que você não deve puxar muitos
partidas, pequeno <$cdef(27)>GastlyCaso contrário, bem...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>I-I won’t! I promise! Please don’t tie me up!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu-Eu não vou! Eu prometo! Por favor, não me amarre!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>*rumble*... I’m so hungry...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, do you have anything I could eat?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>* Rumble *... Estou com tanta fome...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>tem alguma coisa que eu possa comer?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Well, I dooo have some berries...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Bem, tenho umas bagas...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Really? Can I have some, then? I’m so hungry I feel like
I’m gonna collapse...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Sério? Posso ter um pouco, então? Estou com tanta fome que me sinto como
Eu vou desmoronar...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Suuure. They have a little sludge on them, though...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Suuure, eles têm um pouco de lama.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>What’s wrong with that?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>O que há de errado nisso?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,1)>Some Pokémon don’t liiike sludgy berries. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,18)><$voicel(1,8)>But here, you
can have one if you don’t mind...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,1)>Alguns Pokémon não liiike bagas sludgy. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,18)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas aqui, tu...
pode ter um, se você não se importa...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,63)><$voicel(2,8)>Fine with me! Thanks...
<$motion(2,17)><$voicel(2,5)>*chomp*! *munch munch*...<$motion(2,19)>
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa... The sludge makes it so creamy and tasty!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,63)><$voicel(2,8)>Por mim, tudo bem.
<$motion(2,17)><$voicel(2,5)>* Chomp *! * Munch *...<$motion(2,19)>
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>O lodo torna-o tão cremoso e saboroso!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Reeeaaally? I’m glad, then... I guess...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Estou feliz, então... acho que...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah... I like it a lot! It’s so good.
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Ooh, I’ve got an idea. We should try putting sludge on
other foods, too!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Like, on vegetables, and y’know, full meals...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim... Eu gosto muito! É tão bom.
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Ooh, eu tenho uma idéia. Devemos tentar colocar lama em
outras comidas, também!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Tipo, em legumes, e sabe, refeições completas...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh? I dunno... That seems like a lot of wooork...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Não sei, parece-me muito estranho.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>Hmmmmmm... I don’t know what to dooo...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>Hmmmmmm... Eu não sei o que fazer...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Is something the matter?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Passa-se alguma coisa?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Yeeeaaah. You see, um...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>We look kinda similar, riiight? <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>We’re kinda shaped the
same, and we both like the sea, and...yeah...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Sim, está a ver...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Parecemos parecidos, Riiight? <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Nós somos meio que moldou o
O mesmo, e ambos gostamos do mar, e... sim...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Now you mention it, yes. You might be right.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Agora que falas nisso, sim, pode ter razão.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>But I can’t give others riiides on my back like you can.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m so jeeeaaalous that you can, <$cdef(27)>Lapras...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas eu não posso dar outros riilides nas minhas costas como você pode.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu sou tão jeeeaaaous que você pode, <$cdef(27)>Lapras...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Is that so? Well, I’m often told that the shell on my back <$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,4)>is
hard and uncomfortable to ride on.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>So I sometimes feel envious of your soft back.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>É isso mesmo? Bem, muitas vezes me dizem que a concha em minhas costas <$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,4)>é
difícil e desconfortável de andar.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Às vezes sinto inveja das tuas costas macias.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee. You’re gonna make me bluuush. But my back’s
kind of sliiimy and slick, <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>you know? So it’s really difficult
for other Pokémon to stay on top and go for a riiide...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee. Você vai me fazer bluuush. Mas minhas costas
um pouco desleixado e liso, <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>você sabe? Então é realmente difícil
para outro Pokémon ficar no topo e ir para um riiide...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>What’s wrong with that? I imagine all the little ones would
see your back <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>as a fun sort of slide!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>O que há de errado com isso? Eu imagino que todos os pequenos
ver as suas costas <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>como um slide divertido!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I never thought of it thaaat way... That makes me kind of
happy. Thaaanks, <$cdef(27)>Lapras.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Nunca pensei nisso de uma maneira...
Feliz. Thaaanks, <$cdef(27)>Lapras.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey heyyy! You just get back from a nice swim or
somethin’?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Ei, ei, ei, ei, ei!
alguma coisa?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Indeed. I assume you did as well?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Presumo que também o tenhas feito.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You bet I did! What a coincidence, huh? Nothin’ beats
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>swimmin’ in a calm lake! Ya feel me?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Você apostou que eu fiz! Que coincidência, hein? Nada bate
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>nadando em um lago calmo! Você me entende?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Hm? I was in the ocean, actually.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Cutting through the cold, rough waves is most invigorating.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Eu estava no oceano, na verdade.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Cortar as ondas frias e ásperas é muito revigorante.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh wow! Hearin’ you talk about it, a rough ocean swim
sounds kinda fun too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh uau! Ouvindo você falar sobre isso, um mar áspero nadar
Parece divertido também!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I must admit, the notion of swimming in a calm lake
intrigues me, due in no small part to your fondness for it.<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>What about you, <$cdef(27)>? Which do
you
find
most appealing?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Devo admitir, a noção de nadar num lago calmo.
intriga-me, devido em grande parte ao seu gosto por isso.<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>E tu, <$cdef(27)>Que fazem
você
encontrar
Mais atraente?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>You dig the peaceful life too, huh? The air around the lake
is also nice and clean!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Também gostas da vida pacífica?
é também agradável e limpo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Yes, nothing is more thrilling than knowing the unexpected
could occur at any moment.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim, nada é mais emocionante do que conhecer o inesperado.
Pode ocorrer a qualquer momento.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, I was gonna rest a bit...but now I kinda feel <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>like goin’
for another swim! Oof. What to do, what to do...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, eu ia descansar um pouco... mas agora eu meio que sinto <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>como ir’
O que fazer, o que fazer...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>As am I. Heh—what to do, indeed...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Tal como eu. O que fazer, de fato...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh heyyy, <$cdef(27)>Hoppip</color>.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Hoppip</color>.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Hi! We sure run into each other a lot, don’t we?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Oi! Nós com certeza nos encontramos muito, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>That is true... Though I’m just floooaaating around. <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>The
wind chooses where I go...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Isso é verdade... Embora eu só esteja andando por aí. <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>A
vento escolhe para onde eu vou...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>No way?! That’s what I do too!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>De jeito nenhum?! É isso que eu faço também!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh yeeeaaah? It sure is niiice to float around on the wind,
isn’t it?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>É muito bom flutuar no vento.
não é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)>Yeah, it really is!<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)> Wait...do we keep running into each
other <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>’cause of the wind?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, é mesmo!<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)> Espera... continuamos a encontrar-nos com cada um.
outros <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Por causa do vento?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Hehehe... That makes sense... I guess we’ve been floating
on the saaame wind a lot, huh?
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I really like the evening wind myseeelf...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Hehehe... Isso faz sentido... Acho que temos flutuado
no vento de Saaame muito, huh?
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu realmente gosto do vento da noite myseeelf...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, I know what you mean. It gets so nice and cool in the
evening... And the sunset is sooo pretty!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I try catching the wind so I can get a good view!
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>But I like the wind during the day too, y’know.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu sei o que quer dizer.
E o pôr-do-sol é tão bonito!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Tento apanhar o vento para ter uma boa vista!
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas eu gosto do vento durante o dia também, você sabe.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, yeeeaaah... It’s so nice and warm and good for naps.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Sometimes I float reeeaaally high while I’m napping...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, yeeeaaah... É tão agradável e quente e bom para cochilos.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Às vezes eu flutuar reeeaaly alta enquanto eu estou cochilando...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ha! Yeah, that happens to me too! I’m so glad we’ve got
so much in common.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ha! Sim, isso acontece comigo também! Estou tão feliz que temos
Muito em comum.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Me too... I hope we’ll meet agaaaiiin sometime...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu também... Espero que encontremos agaaaiiin algum dia...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>That flower on your head...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Aquela flor na tua cabeça...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? You mean this?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,6)>está a falar disto?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Yeah! I like how it spins around when you jump! It’s
sooo cute!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Sim! Eu gosto de como ele gira ao redor quando você salta! É
Tão fofinho!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Heh heh, thanks. Those leaves on your head are nice too!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>They’re all green and, y’know, leafy.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>As folhas na tua cabeça também são bonitas!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Eles são todos verdes e, você sabe, folhosos.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I know, right? The tips of my leaves are so cool
and pointy!
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>But, still... I really wish I had a flower like yours...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>As pontas das minhas folhas são tão fixes.
E pontiagudo!
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas, mesmo assim... gostava mesmo de ter uma flor como a tua...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, really? Uh, why?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>A sério?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, grass doesn’t really catch the eye, y’know? It’s
just...sometimes I really wanna BLOOM!
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)>It’d be fun to be in the spotlight a little...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, grama não realmente chamar a atenção, você sabe? É
Às vezes, eu quero muito BLOOM!
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)>Seria divertido estar no centro das atenções um pouco...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oooh! I gotcha. But I don’t think you need to worry
about that...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oooh! Eu peguei você. Mas eu não acho que você precisa se preocupar
Sobre isso...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Huh? What do you mean?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>O que quer dizer?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>I mean, it’s not like I always had a flower like this. <$voicel(1,6)>I used to
just have a couple of leaves sticking out.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>So maybe you’ll, y’know, grow a great big flower
someday too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Quero dizer, não é como se eu sempre tivesse uma flor como esta. <$voicel(1,6)>Eu costumava...
Só tenho umas folhas a sair.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Então talvez você, você sabe, crescer uma grande flor
Um dia também!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Really? Wowee! I’ll come show you right as soon as my
flower blooms!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Sério? Uauee! Eu vou mostrar-lhe direito assim que o meu
Flores florescem!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>Hah hah hah, yes! I can’t wait!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>Hah hah hah, sim! Mal posso esperar!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Fluffy fluff and thistledown! ♪ As the day begins...
Feel your feathers ruffled by the gentle morning winds! ♪
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Time to start afresh now! ♪ First, just look up at the sky...
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Look up at the skyyy and... <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh dear. I can’t seem to come
up with a line to follow that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Fofinho e cardo para baixo!
Sinta as suas penas abalada pelos suaves ventos da manhã!
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Primeiro, olha para o céu...
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Olha para o céu e... <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh, querida. Eu não consigo vir
até com uma linha para seguir isso!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, are you composing a song, dear?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>está a compor uma canção, querida?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>That’s right! But I seem to be stuck at the moment... <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Do
you have any good ideas?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Isso mesmo! Mas eu pareço estar preso no momento... <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Fazer
tem alguma boa ideia?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Oh, certainly! I’ll give it a whirl. Let’s see...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Let the breeze whisk you along—it will help you fly! ♪
Traveling together with our friends is so much fun! ♪
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Hm, yes! That has a nice ring to it, if I say so myself!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,8)><$cdef(27)>, dear, could you complete
the
next line?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>That’s why I love... ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Oh, certamente! Eu vou dar-lhe uma volta. Vejamos...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Deixa a brisa levar-te, vai ajudar-te a voar!
Viajar com os nossos amigos é tão divertido!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Soa-me bem, se é que o digo!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,8)><$cdef(27)>Querida, pode completar?
a
Próxima linha?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>É por isso que eu amo...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hee hee! You’ve got the rhythm down perfectly! Next...
Gather ’round, dear Pokémon! Play to your heart’s content! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hee hee! Você tem o ritmo para baixo perfeitamente! Próximo...
Reúnam-se, queridos Pokémon! Joguem com o conteúdo do seu coração!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, what a lovely melody! Moving along, then...
Gather ’round, dear Pokémon! Play to your heart’s content! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, que melodia adorável!
Reúnam-se, queridos Pokémon! Joguem com o conteúdo do seu coração!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Eat some berries, have a nap—that’s a day well spent! ♪
Finally, it’s time to say goodnight beneath a tree... ♪
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,10)>Knowing that another day has passed so happily! ♪
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>...Yes, I think that wraps it up nicely! <$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>What do you think?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Coma algumas bagas, tire uma soneca – isso é um dia bem gasto!
Finalmente, é hora de dizer boa noite debaixo de uma árvore...
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,10)>Sabendo que outro dia passou tão feliz!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>...Sim, acho que isso acaba bem! <$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>O que achas?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Your song gives me a warm and fuzzy feeling... Almost as
though we really did spend <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>a whole lovely day together!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>A tua canção dá-me uma sensação quente e confusa... quase como...
embora nós realmente gastámos <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Um dia todo lindo juntos!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Hee hee! Thank you so much! Singing is so much more
enjoyable when it’s done with friends, after all!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Hee hee! Muito obrigado! Cantar é muito mais
agradável quando é feito com amigos, afinal!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes! What a splendid time!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Que época esplêndida!
